scope: Read-only consistency audit of Roy, Garg, Agarwal, Frauendorf, concepts, research notes and 017/024/031/034/037 artifacts
course_status: Day27 uncredited preview only; Day28 unopened
status: conditional consistency report; no source or shared-page edits

findings.finding: 037 matrix, antimagnetic concept and 017/031 notes consistently state that J^(2)/B(E2) carries units hbar^2 MeV^-1 (e^2 b^2)^-1 and has no universal >=100 hard gate. Frauendorf's quoted 100-200 scale and Roy's source-specific 116-341 range are retained as source/model contexts only.

017, 034, magnetic-rotation and antimagnetic-rotation boundaries all treat j(r) as time odd. They allow a combined antiunitary rotation-time operation to preserve a complete field while separate T is broken; they do not infer pointwise zero current or a mode assignment from a toy residual.

034 and Frauendorf F01-5/F01-8/F01-9 consistently separate oriented TAC mean fields from laboratory good-I states and symmetry restoration. 017/031/034 outputs explicitly label toy currents and frozen-gyro values as non-experimental.

Garg 2015 and Agarwal 2007 both retain relative B(M1)/B(E2) or possible-MR wording and missing absolute lifetimes. 037 correctly records numerator/denominator non-identifiability; no artifact upgrades these candidates to established MR.

The 017 JSON and earlier 017 research text identify Roy Table 1 as printed p.323, while the current Roy source page uses p.324 for RO11-1/Table 1. The scientific values are not changed by this audit, but the source page and direct PDF should be treated as the canonical locator until printed-versus-PDF pagination is reconciled.

findings.topic: Roy Cd values and model boundaries
findings.finding: The 017 Cd transcription (106Cd 0.15->0.05, 108Cd 0.15->0.03 effective endpoint, 110Cd 0.14->0.06) is explicitly source-value arithmetic without propagated uncertainties. Notes reject old 013/014 platform and core-share claims as universal; Roy's core-coupling interpretation remains source-specific.

024, 031 and 034 consistently separate Starosta experimental ~0.37 MeV band displacement, Starosta 12-keV TAC barrier, Olbratowski frozen-gyro hbar omega_c=0.514639 MeV and Olbratowski HF onset ~0.6 MeV. None is treated as a measured critical frequency.

037's ten-row matrix correctly classifies current residuals, multipolarity, absolute B values, ratios, J2, polarization, lifetimes, configuration/alignment and S(I) as necessary inputs, supporting evidence or non-identifying quantities. It agrees with source-level limitations and does not add a universal sufficient criterion.

unresolved: Keep p.324 for Table 1 and p.323 for the preceding lineshape section when using page-only citations.
Do not treat historical superseded artifact values as current evidence even when arithmetic is reproducible.
overall: No physics-level contradiction was found among the audited current boundaries and artifacts. One locator conflict remains for Roy Table 1; it is a metadata issue, not a license to alter the reported values.
